description.summary: which window is on which workspace

protocol.description:
Neither `ext-workspace-v1` nor `wlr-foreign-toplevel-management-v1` links a window to a workspace - the former only knows workspaces, the latter only windows. This protocol fills that one gap: it reports, for every window, which output and workspace index (matching the `index` field ironland-workspaces already reports over `ext-workspace-v1`) it's homed to, identified by title and app id since neither existing protocol exposes a stable id a client could match on instead. Best-effort by construction: two windows with the same title and app id on the same workspace are indistinguishable to a client of this protocol.
A client is expected to clear its accumulated state and rebuild it from the `window` events it receives up to the next `done`, the same snapshot-per-`done` pattern `ext-workspace-v1` itself uses.

arg.name: output
arg.summary: the wl_output name (e.g. eDP-1) it's on

arg.name: workspace
arg.summary: workspace index on that output, matching ext-workspace-v1

event.name: done
event.description: Sent once after every `window` event for the current state has been sent, and again whenever anything changes (a window maps/unmaps, moves workspace, or its title/app id changes).
